Items: a Greek style yogurt pot (~100-170g), a savory bacon/egg muffin, and a milk coffee (latte-style).

Yogurt: Farmers Union Greek style, probably 170g, ~160 kcal (full fat ~ 95 kcal/100g). The label in the second photo appears to say 160g or 170g. The pot is small, so I assume about 160g at ~150 kcal. It was eaten almost entirely.

Muffin: a savory muffin with bacon, about 80g, ~200 kcal. The wrapper remains with a little residue, so about 95% was eaten: ~75g, ~190 kcal.

Coffee: a latte of ~250ml with milk, ~100 kcal. The cup is mostly empty, with a little residue, so about 240g, ~100 kcal.

Total: yogurt 150 + muffin 190 + coffee 100 = 440 kcal. Mass: 160 + 75 + 240 = 475g.
